answer: Give each identity an 18-epoch work atlas: it locks 65 POA and must complete three randomly assigned jobs per round, with five of seven established jurors signing reproducible receipts. One failed round pauses rewards; two failures slash 35% of the bond. Funding-linked identities enter a forge curve where each new bond doubles, so a clone farm pays exponentially to reach the summit of voting weight. The ledger checks task hashes, quorum signatures, timing, and funding ancestry.
